newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan 1996 ethylene output up 2.7 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan 1996 ethylene output up 2.7 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's ethylene output in 1996 grew 2.7 percent from a year ago to 7.13 million tonnes, an official for the Ministry of International Trade and Industry said on Friday.
This is the first time Japan's annual ethylene output has surpassed seven million tonnes, he said.
He also said ethylene output in December totalled 662,000 tonnes, up 5.6 percent from a year earlier amid healthy domestic demand as well as brisk exports to Asian countries.
